title: The Math That Wipes Out 5x Leverage

beats.say: Borrowed money multiplies gains, but it destroys you just as fast.
beats.visual: A towering stack of hundred-dollar bills under harsh industrial lighting, shot from a low angle.

beats.say: Here is the exact math of a 5x leverage play.
beats.visual: A person's hands sliding a single stack of cash away from four larger stacks on a dark wooden table.

beats.say: Take a $100,000 property bought with a $20,000 down payment.
beats.visual: A minimalist architectural model of a modern home sitting alone in a dimly lit concrete room.

beats.say: That is 5x leverage. You control a massive asset with a fraction of your own cash.
beats.visual: A single chess piece standing apart from a dense grid of wooden blocks, cinematic side lighting.

beats.say: If the market climbs 20%, your property is worth $120,000.
beats.visual: A sleek digital wall graph ticking upward in soft blue ambient light, blurred background.

beats.say: Your $20,000 down payment just doubled to $40,000 before costs and interest.
beats.visual: Two stacks of currency standing side by side, illuminated by a sharp spotlight from above.

beats.say: But here is the part nobody mentions when things go wrong.
beats.visual: A pendulum hanging still in a concrete hallway, dramatic shadows cast against the wall.

beats.say: A 20% price drop wipes out the whole down payment instantly.
beats.visual: A hand sweeping a small stack of coins off a dark metal desk into the shadows.

beats.say: Your equity hits zero while you still owe the bank every single dollar.
beats.visual: A blank paper document lying on a scarred wooden tabletop, shot from directly overhead.

beats.say: That is why debt cuts both ways and the risk is entirely yours.
beats.visual: A heavy steel scale balancing unevenly on a concrete floor, cool morning light.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you, because borrowed money
beats.visual: A silhouette of a person walking down a long, narrow corridor toward a faint exit light.

caption: Leverage is a double-edged sword. It builds fortunes when markets rise, and wipes them out instantly when they fall. #leverage #debt #personalfinance #wealthbuilding #moneyrules
description: A breakdown of how 5x leverage works in real estate, the math behind a 20% drop, and why borrowed money magnifies both gains and losses.
first_comment: Would you take 5x leverage on an asset today? Let us know below.

facts.claim: A $100,000 property bought with $20,000 down is 5x leverage; a 20% price drop ($20,000) wipes out the whole down payment, a 20% rise doubles it
